🚀 OVERVIEW

TheMINIMAX H3 // 4 STEPS TURBO VIDEO AIOworkflow has been designed to makeMiniMax H3 video generation as fast, intuitive and efficient as possiblewhile keeping the workflow clean and beginner-friendly.

Instead of exposing dozens of disconnected nodes, everything has been carefully organized into logical production stages, making the workflow easy to understand, easy to customize and suitable for both beginners and experienced ComfyUI users.

Whether your goal is to generate a cinematic video from a text prompt or create an animation guided by reference images, this workflow provides a streamlined production pipeline from start to finish.

⚡ MAIN FEATURES

✅ Text → Video

✅ First Frame → Video

✅ First + Last Frame animation

✅ Native Audio Generation

✅ 4 Steps Turbo Workflow

✅ Optional Prompt Enhancer (Qwen VLM)

✅ RTX Video Super Resolution (optional)

✅ Automatic Video Export

✅ Optimized node organization

✅ Cyberpunk / Anime themed interface

🎬 WHAT THIS WORKFLOW CAN DO

  • Generate high-quality videos in only4 inference steps

  • Create videos directly from text prompts

  • Animate from a single reference image

  • Control both the first and last frame for better temporal consistency

  • Generate synchronized native audio

  • Enhance prompts automatically using Qwen VLM

  • Upscale the final result using NVIDIA RTX Video Super Resolution

  • Produce ready-to-share MP4 videos

Simply open the workflow and follow the built-in documentation.

🎮 WORKFLOW MODES

TEXT TO VIDEO

Generate a complete video from a prompt.

FIRST FRAME MODE

Guide the animation using a starting image.

Perfect for maintaining character identity and composition.

FIRST + LAST FRAME MODE

Control both the beginning and the ending of the animation for improved consistency.

PROMPT ENHANCER

Enable it if you want AI to automatically rewrite and improve your prompt.

Disable it if you prefer to keep your original prompt untouched.

RTX VIDEO UPSCALER

Optional AI upscaling after generation for maximum image quality.

Recommended for final renders only.
